---
title: "Obtenir un fournisseur"
api: "GET https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors/{id}"
description: "Récupérer un fournisseur par ID"
---

## Authentification

<ParamField header="Authorization" type="string" required>
  Jeton Bearer pour l'authentification
</ParamField>

## Portées requises

- `vendors.read`

## Paramètres de chemin

<ParamField path="id" type="integer" required>
  L'identifiant unique du fournisseur
</ParamField>

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request GET \
  --url https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors/12345 \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'
```

```javascript JavaScript
const vendor = await client.vendors.get(12345);
```

```python Python
vendor = client.vendors.get(12345)
```

```csharp C#
var vendor = await client.Vendors.GetAsync(12345);
```

</RequestExample>

<ResponseExample>

```json Response
{
  "id": 12345,
  "name": "Acme Supplies Inc.",
  "website": "https://acmesupplies.com",
  "logo": "https://acmesupplies.com/logo.png",
  "email": "contact@acmesupplies.com",
  "phoneNumber": "+1-555-123-4567",
  "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
}
```

</ResponseExample>
